label: Microsoft Azure
description: Serverless (Functions, API Management, Cosmos DB, Blob Storage), web (Application Gateway, virtual machines, scale sets) and networking (virtual networks, subnets, NAT gateways, network security groups).

types.label: Function app
types.description: Runs functions on demand. HTTP-triggered functions are called at the Azure Functions endpoint; its managed identity's role assignments decide what it may access. With virtual network integration, place it in a subnet: its outbound traffic then goes through the virtual network.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: For example node or python. Informational only.

anonymous.title: Anonymous
anonymous.description: The HTTP trigger's authorization level is anonymous: anyone may call it. Otherwise callers need a function key, which API Management and Application Gateway backends hold, or a role assignment.

roleAssignments.title: Role assignments
roleAssignments.description: What its managed identity may do. A new identity has no role assignments.

zoneRedundant.title: Zone redundant
zoneRedundant.description: Zone redundancy of its hosting plan (Flex Consumption, Premium or Dedicated). Without it, Azure does not spread it across availability zones.

types.label: API Management
types.description: A managed API gateway that routes requests to backends such as function apps. Each API also holds the credentials to call its backend.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: public: reachable from the internet. private: internal virtual network mode; place it in a subnet.

apis.title: APIs
apis.description: Each API forwards requests on a path to a backend and holds the credentials to call it.

zoneRedundant.title: Zone redundant
zoneRedundant.description: Premium tier with units in two or more availability zones.

types.label: Cosmos DB account
types.description: A managed NoSQL database. Access requires a data-plane role assignment.

zoneRedundant.title: Zone redundant
zoneRedundant.description: Availability zone support in its region. Without it, the account's replicas in a region may share one zone.

types.label: Blob container
types.description: Object storage in a storage account. Access requires a role assignment unless anonymous read access is on.

anonymousRead.title: Anonymous read
anonymousRead.description: Whether anyone on the internet may read blobs. It also needs blob public access allowed on the storage account, which new accounts turn off.

zoneRedundant.title: Zone redundant
zoneRedundant.description: ZRS or GZRS. LRS and GRS keep the copies in the primary region in one datacenter.

types.label: Virtual network
types.description: A private network. Components in its subnets reach each other, subject to network security groups. Components with a public IP address reach the internet and can be reached from it through Azure's system routes; other components need a NAT gateway on their subnet to open connections to the internet. Subnets span every availability zone of the region.

addressSpace.title: Address space
addressSpace.description: The virtual network's IPv4 address range, for example 10.1.0.0/16. Used by the detailed analysis level.

types.label: Subnet
types.description: A part of a virtual network; place it in the virtual network. A NAT gateway or a network security group can be associated with it.

addressPrefix.title: Address prefix
addressPrefix.description: The subnet's IPv4 address range within its virtual network, for example 10.1.1.0/24. Used by the detailed analysis level.

types.label: Network security group
types.description: A stateful firewall for the subnets and components it is associated with. Its default rules allow traffic within the virtual network and outbound traffic to the internet.

rules.title: Security rules
rules.description: Checked in priority order (lowest number first); the first match decides. After them, the default rules allow traffic within the virtual network and outbound traffic to the internet, and deny everything else. Stateful: replies are allowed automatically.

peer.title: Peer
peer.description: any, internet, network (the VirtualNetwork service tag), the id of a component, subnet or virtual network, or an IPv4 range such as 10.0.0.0/16 (matched at the detailed level).

ports.title: Ports
ports.description: Port ids (https), numbers (443) or ranges (8080-8090). Omitted: all ports.

associations.title: Associations
associations.description: The subnets and components (network interfaces) it is associated with.

types.label: NAT gateway
types.description: Gives the subnets it is associated with outbound connections to the internet, without a route table. A zonal NAT gateway lives in one availability zone.

subnets.title: Subnets
subnets.description: The subnets it is associated with.

zones.title: Availability zones
zones.description: The availability zones it runs in. Empty: no zone is chosen, and it runs in one.

types.label: Virtual machine
types.description: A virtual machine. Place it in a subnet and associate network security groups with it or its subnet.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: public: it has a public IP address. private: only a private address.

zones.title: Availability zones
zones.description: The availability zone it runs in. Empty: no zone is chosen.

roleAssignments.title: Role assignments
roleAssignments.description: What its managed identity may do. A new identity has no role assignments.

types.label: Virtual machine scale set
types.description: A group of equivalent virtual machines running an application. Place it in a subnet; its zones say which availability zones its instances run in.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: public: every instance has a public IP address. private: only private addresses.

zones.title: Availability zones
zones.description: The availability zones its instances run in. Empty: no zone is chosen.

roleAssignments.title: Role assignments
roleAssignments.description: What its managed identity may do. A new identity has no role assignments.

types.label: Application Gateway
types.description: Distributes HTTP(S) requests to backends such as scale sets, virtual machines or function apps. Place it in its own subnet; its zones say which availability zones it runs in.

frontend.title: Endpoint
frontend.description: public: a public frontend IP address. private: a private frontend only.

backends.title: Backends
backends.description: Each rule forwards requests on a path to a backend.

zones.title: Availability zones
zones.description: The availability zones it runs in. Empty: no zone is chosen.
